launches.body:
Hey! We're [George](https://www.linkedin.com/in/georgejeffers/) and [Art](https://www.linkedin.com/in/artfreebrey/), co-founders of [Revnu](https://revnu.com/).

**TL;DR**

[Revnu](https://revnu.com/) is your AI growth hire. Connect your tools and our agents run every growth channel in parallel. Outbound, SEO, ads, short form content + more. You focus on building, we focus on growing.

<https://youtu.be/cL_dwhuRvGM>

**The problem**

AI solved coding. Building software has never been easier and the cost is collapsing to 0.

The only moat left is distribution.

Founders don’t want to worry about managing email outbound campaigns, ad budgets, blog articles. They’re busy shipping and talking to customers. 

The options today are: hire a growth hire for $200k/yr or hack your own DIY tool stack together.

Until now! 

**Our solution**

What Cursor did for coding, we're doing for growth.

[Revnu](https://revnu.com/) runs every growth channel for you, in parallel, 24/7:

* Cold outbound that finds you leads, drafts emails in your voice and books you calls
* Runs thousands of ad creative variants on Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok
* Gets you ranking in Google and AI search
* Creates short-form video content
* Catches customers about to churn and wins them back

Now founders can finally focus on getting back to building.

**About us**

We're George and Art, both from the UK. We met in school when we were 14 years old and have been best friends ever since. We both dropped out of university the same day to join YC P26 and moved to San Francisco.

* Before [Revnu](https://revnu.com/), we bootstrapped multiple businesses and kept on finding growth was the bottleneck.
* That's why we decided to build [Revnu](http://revnu.com/). To automate the part of every founder's life they hate the most: the growth work.

**Our ask**

If you're a technical founder and you hate doing growth (or you know someone who does), book a demo rn at [revnu.com](http://revnu.com).

Love & Guidance

\- George and Art
